notes: Phase A historical roster — 12 figures. Each entry contains only id, name, era, lifespan, and source_anchors. Per-figure 'context' field was eliminated in v0.3 after v0.2 priming was found to contain editorial / axis-direction framing. v0.4 expands the v0.3 8-figure roster to 12 with the addition of Augustus, Napoleon, Stalin, and Gandhi. Provenance and roster-selection rationale (including hypothesis-relevant motivation for the v0.4 additions) are documented in the project changelog at repo/papers/CHANGELOG.md, deliberately kept out of this runtime data file. Primed v0.2 file archived at working/data-archive/figures-v0.2-primed.json.
